title: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg embraces Halloween with Michael Myers costume

 Marcus D. Smith USA TODAY Oct. 30, 2026 Updated Oct. 31, 2026, 2:18 a.m. ET Hear this story SAN FRANCISCO — Friday night on Halloween eve the Golden State Warriors welcomed the Los Angeles Lakers to the Chase Center for an NBA Cup Group Stage game .
 Warriors rookie forward Yaxel Lendeborg displayed his Halloween spirit by arriving to Friday’s matchup wearing a Michael Myers costume, from the famed horror film "Halloween. "
 "I had no idea what I wanted to be," Lendeborg told reporters after the game. "I think I tried to get a Nick Cannon costume, from 'Love Don't Cost A Thing,' but it didn't come in time.  So I went to the Spirit Halloween store yesterday. That was the only thing they had in my size."
 So, it seems it was more spirited fun than statement.
 YAXEL LENDEBORG: Warriors rookie's historic start is Shaq-like All things Warriors: Latest Golden State Warriors news, schedule, roster, stats, injury updates and more. NBA CUP WINNERS AND LOSERS: 76ers edge Knicks in group of death In the teams' last matchup, the Warriors rookie was tasked with guarding Lakers MVP candidate Luka Doncic. Individually, he held him to 1-for-5 shooting, which included Dončić banking in a half court buzzer-beater going into halftime.
 Although Dončić scored 28 in that game, Lendeborg said he lost all respect for the Lakers superstar.
 "I had a lot of respect for him," Lendeborg said after the Oct. 21 matchup. "I didn't watch the NBA much. I just watched highlights, seeing him kill people all the time. But then being in there first hand, just watching him whining and complaining, I lost all respect, man. Like, that was awful.
 "I was letting him know because he was laughing and talking all this because of that one foul call,” he added. “His only bucket on me was a banker from half court."
 Dončić said Lendeborg was talking crazy. It was his welcome to the NBA moment. It was a given that the two would have another moment on Friday night during their rematch. Here's how the Lendeborg-Dončić matchup went.
 Luka Dončić vs Yaxel Lendeborg
 Dončić, when guarded by Lendeborg on Friday, Oct. 30, went 1-for-3 in the first quarter. Against everyone else, the Lakers superstar scored 21 points. The Lakers led 38-15 after the first 12 minutes. Dončić had 24 points at halftime.
 --> He had 35 after three quarters and ended with 37.
 Lendeborg finished with six points, but the Warriors got the win.
